account.notes:
SOURCE OF TRUTH: the developer's Google Drive share (link in developerCloudUrl; CONTRACT CLAUSE 5: the link is private and confidential — never give it or any link inside it to a client or third party). One folder per city (Larnaca / Limassol / Nicosia projects, Larnaca Rentals), one subfolder per project with a "Pricelist - ..." PDF, brochure, specs, renders. Price lists are per-unit tables with SOLD / RESERVED / HOLD markers; HOLD = not released = treated as reserved. All prices exclude VAT.

SCOPE (operator 2026-11-04: "ignore Rentals and Sold Out projects"): imported 11 products. OUT: all "(SOLD)" folders (Aria Gardens, Armonia, Estia, Galatea, Iliada, Berengaria, Cleo Court, Actaion 12), Elandra Villas (price list: 9 sold + 1 reserved = nothing available), Larnaca Rentals (Patroclos Tower offices), Drysea Residences and Elnaz Court (empty folders), Roxana Court 303 (single resale, reserved). OPEN, not imported pending operator decision: Victoria Court (Pervolia; price list 30-05-2024, all 10 shown available, not on the developer's website) and Olympic Mansions M8 (no price list, only architecture set + 4 images). Horizon is split into two pages: Horizon Residences (4 residential blocks) and Horizon Business Centre (commercial block, own price list).

WHERE SOURCES DISAGREE THE PRICE LIST WINS (same rule as DTA/Marinakis). The website patroclos.com.cy shows older/looser statuses (e.g. Elandra villa 8 "available" vs list RESERVED; Ethera 201-205 "available" vs list HOLD; Olivea A18 "available" with no price anywhere -> not imported as available).

MONTHLY: re-download the price lists from the Drive share, re-transcribe into scripts/data/patroclos/<date>.json, dry run scripts/patroclos-sync.mjs, then --apply.

CONTRACT: Co-operation Agreement dated 04/11/2026, 12 months, no automatic renewal, 7% of the net (ex-VAT) purchase price, payable within 7 bank days after the developer receives 40% of the contract price, against our invoice. Registration of a client must be confirmed in writing (deemed accepted after 3 working days), valid 6 months; fee due if the purchase contract is signed within 12 months of registration (also spouse/company). Clause 6.1: we may show properties and prices on our website; must remove within 3 days on request. Clause 9.1: promoting Patroclos' name or project names in advertising needs their WRITTEN PRE-APPROVAL. The scanned copy on file is signed by CVE only (Party A signature pending).
